usage:
require "openai"

client = Openai::Client.new(api_key: ENV["OPENAI_API_KEY"])

result = client.admin.organization.projects.api_keys.retrieve("project_id", "api_key_id")
pp result

fields.name: object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `organization.project.api_key`

fields.name: redacted_value
fields.description: The redacted value of the API key

fields.name: name
fields.description: The name of the API key

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the API key was created

fields.name: last_used_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the API key was last used.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints
